ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In Figure ①, there is a low-pressure wave and curved isobars in the middle of the region, the low-pressure center is not yet obvious, there is a frontal zone on the east side, and a high pressure can be seen on the southeast side; in Figure ④, the isobars near the eastern frontal cloud-rain area are denser, the low-pressure system deepens and develops, and the position of the low-pressure center is more eastward and northward than in Figure ①; in Figure ②, the low-pressure center has already moved near the northeast edge of the map frame, the main system continues to move out toward the northeast, and the western high-pressure range expands; in Figure ③, the low pressure and frontal zone have basically left this region, and the region is mainly controlled by high pressure. Reasoning: Weather systems usually go through the process of initial formation of a low-pressure wave, deepening and development of low pressure, the low-pressure center moving to the northeast edge and moving out, and high-pressure control after the low pressure leaves. Therefore, the chronological order of the four diagrams is ①→④→②→③.

<image1>

According to the development process of the weather system, the chronological order of the four weather maps is ______.

method.method_draft: 先描述四图的气压场：①为低压波动初生，④为低压加深发展，②为低压中心移至东北边缘，③为低压离开后高压控制。依据天气系统的发展阶段由弱到强再到移出、消散排序，得到①→④→②→③，即1423。
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图①中，区域中部有低压波动和弯曲等压线，低压中心尚不明显，东侧有锋区，东南侧可见高压；图④中，东部锋面云雨区附近等压线更密集，低压系统加深并发展，低压中心位置较图①偏东偏北；图②中，低压中心已经移到图幅东北边缘附近，主体系统继续向东北方向移出，西侧高压范围扩大；图③中，低压和锋区基本离开本区域，区域内以高压控制为主。推理：天气系统通常经历低压波动初生、低压加深发展、低压中心移至东北边缘并移出、低压离开后高压控制的过程。因此四幅图的时间先后为①→④→②→③。
